results.title: object click as the bot does it (Interact, then ClickWorld): does a waypoint open
results.reason: RISK PROVEN: the bot's object click (Interact unsupported, then cmd move onto the object) does not operate it; only `cmd interact <index>` does

results.observed: Interact(object) err "input: not supported by this backend: interact with unit type 2 (objects have no cmd verb)"; waypoint open after the ClickWorld fallback (cmd move onto it): false; after `cmd interact <index>`: true; 366 ticks
